bead.title: Add approved project spec
bead.description: Track writing and landing the approved Tendril project specification in SPEC.md so implementation workers can use it as the contract. This covers the finalized stateless Rust CLI, in-repo generic mcp-cli crate, discovery/capture/run/audio/alias surface, testing strategy, Nix environment, and release expectations.
bead.creator: helsinki:tendril:helsinki-tendril-tndrl-boot

bead.title: Bootstrap Rust workspace and Nix environment
bead.description: Implement the foundation scaffolding from SPEC.md sections 'Architecture' and 'Build Environment'. Create the Rust workspace skeleton for the `tendril` binary and in-repo `mcp-cli` crate, plus `flake.nix`, `.envrc`, `.cacophony/config.yaml`, and fast pre-merge hook scaffolding. Acceptance criteria: repo enters via `use flake`; builds expose workspace packages/checks; local config declares build/test/bootstrap commands; no application feature logic beyond scaffolding; foundation is ready for parallel feature work.

bead.title: Build generic in-repo mcp-cli crate
bead.description: Implement the reusable `mcp-cli` crate from SPEC.md sections 'Architecture', 'MCP exposure model', and Feature 4. The crate must generically support exposing typed CLI command surfaces as MCP tools over stdio, plus shared `--json` result plumbing, without hard-coding Tendril-specific types. Acceptance criteria: API is generic enough to move to a separate repo later; tool schemas derive from typed command definitions where practical; a sample secondary command surface or equivalent proof demonstrates the crate is not Tendril-specific.
bead.creator: helsinki:tendril:helsinki-tendril-tndrl-boot

bead.title: Add shared command models, config, errors, and JSON envelopes
bead.description: Implement the platform-agnostic core described in SPEC.md sections 'Architecture', 'Tendril config', 'Error Handling', 'Logging and Observability', and 'Agent-friendly UX'. Define typed command inputs/outputs, config loading from `$TENDRIL_CONFIG_DIR/config.yaml`, structured error categories, and reusable JSON success/error envelopes used by both CLI and MCP. Acceptance criteria: shared models cover list/capture/run/listen/alias concepts; config defaults are typed and validated; JSON responses are stable and machine-readable; logs are structured and safe for MCP stdio.
bead.creator: helsinki:tendril:helsinki-tendril-tndrl-boot

bead.title: Implement platform adapter spine and capability probing
bead.description: Implement the cross-platform adapter boundary from SPEC.md sections 'Architecture', 'Audio capture', and 'Security'. Define adapter interfaces for target discovery, capture, input control, permissions, and audio capability probing across macOS, Linux, and Windows 11. Acceptance criteria: unsupported features return structured capability errors; permission checks are explicit and actionable; adapters hide platform-specific details behind a stable internal interface; no daemon or hidden state is introduced.
bead.creator: helsinki:tendril:helsinki-tendril-tndrl-boot

bead.title: Set up tag-triggered CI and release workflow
bead.description: Implement the SPEC.md CI/CD and release-pipeline requirements. Add GitHub Actions workflows that trigger on tag pushes, run the appropriate reproducible checks for this Rust + Nix project, and prepare release artifacts without relying on per-commit remote CI. Acceptance criteria: workflow definitions are present and documented; tag-triggered validation and release steps align with the flake/build/test strategy; local pre-merge expectations remain intact; the repository stays green under the managed validation flow.

bead.title: Make macOS Tendril binary self-contained; remove runtime Swift dependency
bead.description:
Operator report: running Tendril on macOS currently fails during target discovery with `swift` missing at runtime (`error: tool 'swift' not found`). This violates the approved spec contract that every command is self-contained and causes an opaque platform adapter failure instead of reaching the expected permission-guided path (for example Screen Recording / Accessibility guidance).

Observed evidence:
- `crates/tendril/src/discovery.rs` shells out to `swift -e` for macOS target discovery.
- `crates/tendril/src/platform.rs` shells out to `swift -e` for multiple macOS input/focus paths.
- README/spec position Tendril as a self-contained binary and require structured permission/capability errors.

Required outcome:
- macOS `tendril list`, `capture`, and `run` must not require a runtime Swift toolchain/Xcode installation.
- The packaged binary must either use native Rust/linked platform APIs or another packaged self-contained mechanism.
- Missing macOS permissions must surface as structured permission guidance, not missing-tool/runtime adap failures.
- `nix run .#tendril` on macOS must be a supported operator path.
bead.creator: ms-mac:tui

bead.title: Add true macOS self-contained end-to-end smoke coverage for Tendril binary flows
bead.description:
Add self-hosted macOS smoke coverage that exercises the actual packaged Tendril launch path instead of only unit/parity helpers. The goal is to catch missing runtime dependencies and permission-flow regressions before operators do.

Coverage expectations:
- launch the Tendril binary via the release-facing or `nix run .#tendril` path on macOS,
- verify `tendril list` reaches either successful structured output or explicit structured permission guidance,
- verify failures are not due to missing runtime tools such as `swift`,
- include at least one capture/input-oriented permission-guidance assertion where full permissions are not available, and
- preserve the stateless/self-contained contract in the assertions.

This bead complements bd-5c3937 by preventing regressions once the runtime Swift dependency is removed.
bead.creator: helsinki:tendril:helsinki-tendril-tndrl-ctrl

bead.title: Implement target discovery for windows and displays
bead.description: Implement Feature 1 from SPEC.md plus the target semantics in 'Architecture'. Add `tendril list` support for windows and displays/desktops with stable per-session IDs, bounds, scale info, titles/names where available, and flags indicating capture/input support. Acceptance criteria: `tendril list --json` returns structured targets; permission failures are classified cleanly; multiple targets are distinguishable unambiguously; output is consumable by later capture and run commands.
bead.creator: helsinki:tendril:helsinki-tendril-tndrl-boot

bead.title: Add alias helpers and zero-argument agent help
bead.description: Implement Features 6 and 7 from SPEC.md. Add `tendril alias` shell helper emission for repeated targeting and make `tendril` with no arguments print concise agent-oriented workflow help. Acceptance criteria: alias output is shell-usable and transparent; it does not depend on hidden Tendril state; help text explains the list -> capture -> run workflow; JSON metadata is available where appropriate.
bead.creator: helsinki:tendril:helsinki-tendril-tndrl-boot

bead.title: Expose Tendril commands over MCP stdio
bead.description: Implement Feature 4 from SPEC.md. Add `tendril mcp stdio` and wire discovery, capture, and input execution into MCP tools through the shared typed command model and generic `mcp-cli` crate. Acceptance criteria: MCP tool schemas align with CLI inputs; structured success/error payloads are equivalent between CLI JSON and MCP; stdio logging is protocol-safe; initial tool set covers list, capture, and run.
bead.creator: helsinki:tendril:helsinki-tendril-tndrl-boot

bead.title: Implement audio capture command surface and capability handling
bead.description: Implement Feature 5 from SPEC.md. Add `tendril listen` support for loopback/system audio and microphone/input-device capture where supported, with structured capability and permission diagnostics on unsupported paths. Acceptance criteria: command surface identifies source type, format, and duration settings; capability probing distinguishes unsupported from transient failure; JSON output is agent-consumable. If full parity is not feasible for v0.0.1, preserve a shippable slice and document the gap explicitly.
bead.creator: helsinki:tendril:helsinki-tendril-tndrl-boot

bead.title: Implement input DSL and target-scoped action execution
bead.description: Implement Feature 3 from SPEC.md. Add `tendril --window <id> run <input-definition>` support for plain text entry and the initial DSL action set: key taps, `hold`, `release`, `send`, `wait`, `lclick`, `rclick`, `mclick`, and `drag`. Acceptance criteria: parser validates syntax precisely; execution errors identify the failing action/stage; coordinate actions are source-space correct using capture mapping metadata; implementation uses the most reliable native/input accessibility APIs available and reports when focus transfer is required.
bead.creator: helsinki:tendril:helsinki-tendril-tndrl-boot

bead.title: Implement screenshot capture with resize mapping metadata
bead.description: Implement Feature 2 from SPEC.md. Add `tendril capture --window <id>` and `tendril capture --display <id>` with `--max-width`, `--max-height`, `--format`, and `--compression`, returning original/output dimensions plus scale mapping metadata so agents can remap coordinates after resizing. Acceptance criteria: both display and window capture paths work on supported platforms; validation rejects conflicting flags; structured JSON and MCP-compatible results include remapping data and timestamps.
bead.creator: helsinki:tendril:helsinki-tendril-tndrl-boot

bead.title: macos and linux capture implementations are incomplete / lazy
bead.description:
unsupported capability: macOS discovery requires system Python with AppKit and Quartz available to the invoking user session.
 and unsupported capability: Target discovery requires a detected interactive X11 desktop session.. We should support macos natively via accessibility APIs like e.g. yabai / skhd, and on linux we should have wayland support too
bead.creator: ms-mac:tui
